rules.name: Mandatory Document Completeness
rules.description: Verifies that all documents required for the application category are uploaded and readable

rules.name: Statutory Validity & Expiry Check
rules.description: Checks if statutory certificates (Fire NOC, Affiliation, Registration) are valid for the upcoming academic session

rules.name: Trust & Institution Entity Name Consistency
rules.description: Cross-verifies legal entity and institution names across Trust Deed, Land Deed, Fire NOC and Application Form

rules.name: Land Area & Title Verification
rules.description: Ensures registered land area in Title Deed matches declared area and fulfills AICTE minimum handbook norms

rules.name: Cross-Application Duplicate Document Detection
rules.description: Computes SHA-256 cryptographic digest of each file to detect identical documents reused across different institutions

rules.name: Error Level Analysis & Tamper Forensics
rules.description: Analyzes compression error disparity, localized noise variance, and digital editing software signatures (Photoshop, Canva)

rules.name: Reused Government Identifiers
rules.description: Detects if Society Registration Numbers, Land Khasra/Survey Numbers, or Fire NOC numbers are already mapped to another institution

rules.name: Chronological Sequence Sanity
rules.description: Verifies that issue dates respect physical chronology (e.g., Trust formed BEFORE land purchase BEFORE building plan)

rules.name: Campus Photo Geotag & Timestamp Sanity
rules.description: Extracts EXIF GPS coordinates and timestamp from campus photographs and compares with declared site location

rules.name: Computer Vision Floor Plan & Classroom Count
rules.description: Analyzes floor plan architectural layouts to count instructional rooms and verify instructional carpet area

rules.name: Government Issuing Authority Cross-Verification
rules.description: Queries State Land Revenue, Fire Services Directorate, and Registrar of Societies API endpoints to confirm records
